Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
By the way, did you know our school used to have a tea room？
Huh, really？
Yes. They gathered girls who wanted to, and taught tea ceremony and flower arranging.
Huh. But I wonder if anyone wanted to. That kind of thing seems kind of old-fashioned...
Naive. You still don't know much about girls, do you？
Somewhere in their hearts, girls want to be ladylike.
It's not about old or new.
Is that how it is？
Yes. Tea ceremony and flower arranging have a long tradition. They're a kind of beauty.
Girls are sensitive to beauty, after all.
So... it's the same as wanting to be pretty？
Well, something like that. Hehe, do you understand girls a little better now？
You need to study up on lots more too, okay？
Anegasaki
Remember how I told you about the tea room the other day？
Yeah, the one where they taught girls who wanted to learn, right？
Yes. Apparently the person teaching back then was the classical Japanese teacher.
Huh. I wonder what that teacher's doing now？
Apparently retired a long time ago. And since no one used it anymore, it got remodeled.
Huh. Kind of a waste, maybe？
A waste？
Yeah. If that teacher were still around, maybe I could've seen ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ making tea.
Hehe, I wonder.
But it's true, if I had the chance to learn, I'd like to try...
Yeah, thinking that, it's a bit of a shame.
Anegasaki
Remember the classical Japanese teacher who taught tea？
Yeah, retired a long time ago, right？
Well, apparently after she quit teaching, she opened a school and still takes students.
Was she that important a teacher？
Seems so. Actually, she only came as a part-time instructor; that was her real profession.
Huh... then her teaching must have been the real deal.
Hey... you said the other day you wanted to see me make tea, right？
I did, but don't tell me...
Yes. I'm thinking of going to learn... what do you think？
I'd love to say "definitely"... but doesn't it seem kind of strict？ Will you be okay？
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried, but...
But I'm drawn to the idea of being a "Yamato Nadeshiko," the ideal Japanese woman...
Anegasaki
About learning tea ceremony...
Yeah. So what did you decide？
I'm not doing it. Actually, when I looked into it, the monthly fee was really high.
Makes sense when you think about it. It wasn't something I could afford.
...I see, that's a little disappointing.
No, I'm fine.
...But you finally made up your mind...
It's not like I absolutely had to do it. It was just something I admired.
I see...
Besides, I realized something more important.
Like what？
If I start lessons, I won't have time after school anymore, right？
(What does that mean, exactly？)
Anegasaki
The other day, when I was cleaning the materials room, I found something interesting.
Huh？ What is it？
An old map of this area, from way back.
Even the social studies teacher didn't know it was there.
When they looked into it, it turned out to be over 100 years old.
That's amazing. I wonder what this place was like back then？
Where the school is... was actually a big cemetery.
...Really？
Just kidding. Sorry, that was a lie. It was actually woods. Kind of boring, huh.
Well, that's how it goes.
But it was kind of fun, so I'm thinking of looking at it again if I get the chance.
The symbols are different from modern maps, so it's pretty hard to read.
Huh. Tell me if you find anything else interesting.
Anegasaki
Do you remember the old map we talked about？
Yeah, the 100-year-old map of this area, right？
Right. We had cleaning again the other day, so I looked at it.
Find anything？
You see, what do you think used to be where Dixie's is？
...A cemetery？
Geez... no, apparently it was a big mansion.
A mansion？
Yes. A huge house, and right about where the restaurant is, there was a detached annex.
Even though it was an annex, it was as big as a whole house.
Huh... they must've been pretty rich.
I guess. The social studies teacher got really interested and said they'd look into it.
If I find anything else out, I'll tell you. Hehe.
Hey, did you find out anything about the mansion we were talking about？
Anegasaki
Ah, yeah...
Eh？ What's wrong？
The social studies teacher looked into it... and apparently there was a sad story about that annex.
Is that so...？ What kind of story？
The family had a daughter, and she had someone she loved, but her parents opposed it and forced them apart.
...Sounds like something that'd happen back then. Especially with rich families.
Right... and the daughter got sick from the shock...
So apparently the master of the house built the annex so no one would see her.
Whoa, that's awful... that's basically locking her up.
To think we've been working somewhere with such a sad story... haah.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲, hey, hey！
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's wrong？
About that annex story the other day...
Yeah, that sad story, right？
Well, when they looked into it more, they found out what happened after.
What happened after？
Right. The man who was torn from the daughter came back a few years later.
Eh？
He worked hard, made his business a success... and asked the master once more to approve of him and the daughter.
And？
Of course, they got happily married, obviously？
...Ah, it's so moving to work somewhere so wonderful.
Sure, but... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, your reaction's totally different from last time...
Anegasaki
Hey, have you ever bought lunch at the school store？
Yeah, I have.
I heard there's a huge battle over it, is that true？
It's pretty well known. Popular breads sell out right away.
Huh. What kind of bread is popular？
Hmm, I don't know the details... the katsu sandwich, maybe？ It sells a lot.
Ah, I've heard about that. A guy in my class is selling them to other students.
Selling them？
It's popular, so apparently some people will pay a premium.
So... he's running a business. Wow, impressive.
People wanting it that badly, that katsu sandwich must be really good.
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, I tried that famous katsu sandwich the other day.
Huh, how was it？
Hmm... it was good, but...
Maybe a bit too filling. And I worry about the oil.
I see. The sports club guys seem to love it, though.
Well, people who move a lot might say that. But it's kind of a boy thing.
Huh... but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how'd you manage to buy one？ It's a madhouse every day.
Hehe... you see, I asked someone to buy it for me.
...W-Who？
A se-cret. Hehe. Don't worry. It's not a boyfriend or anything.
D-don't say things like that. I am your boyfriend, you know...
Don't worry about it. Getting jealous over something like that... so cute▼
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Anegasaki
Hm？ Huh, what's wrong, you look worried.
About that katsu sandwich thing the other day... remember？
Of course. It was good but kind of filling, right？
No, about when you got it... I mean.
Ah... hehe. Bothered about it？
Well, yeah. It'd be tough for a girl to buy one in that free-for-all...
So, what？
So that means a guy bought it for you. You can't expect me not to worry.
Geez, you're the only one for me, so why doubt me？ Big sis is sad.
(Even if she says that... no way, I'm definitely worried！)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. About the tonkatsu sandwich...
Anegasaki
Still worried？ It's really nothing.
Don't hide it, tell me. Lately I've been so worried I can barely eat.
Really？
Well...
I see. Well... it was a teacher.
No way... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... with a teacher...
No, no, it's not like that.
You see, I went to see the teacher at lunch, and he was eating a katsu sandwich. So I just asked him to share a bit.
I see... oh, thank goodness.
Ah... you really were worried. That was mean of me. As an apology, I'll treat you to a katsu sandwich next time.
(I've had enough of katsu sandwiches...)
Anegasaki
Sudden question. Please answer honestly without being shy. Okay？
Wh-what is it？
Do you like girls in school uniforms？ Please answer yes or no.
What kind of question is that？
Just answer. I'm not going to judge your tastes, so be honest.
Even if you say that... neither yes nor no...
That won't do. Pick one. I won't get mad, okay？
Hmm... well, it depends on the uniform... but if anything...
If anything？
Um... y-yes... I guess...
I see. I knew it. Haah.
(Wh-what on earth was that question？)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what was that question the other day about？
Anegasaki
Question？ What question？
You know, whether I like girls in uniforms.
Ah, that. Should I tell you... want to know？
Well, yeah. When you ask like that, I can't help wondering.
Hmm... but if I tell you, you'll probably laugh.
I won't laugh.
Then... ah, no, never mind. You'll definitely laugh.
(I won't laugh... but if she's this worried, I can't really ask... hmm, so curious...)
Anegasaki
Hey, I have another question？
Another one？ What is it this time？
Did you know there's a new school near the station a little further down？
Huh, really？ I didn't know.
Really？ Lots of their students ride from that station, you don't know？
Not at all.
I see... then that's fine. Ah, but they come to work sometimes, you know？ You really don't know？
I said I don't know... um, what's that school's uniform like？ If I knew that...
I can't tell you that... that would be like helping the enemy.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what on earth are you talking about!?)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, about that new school...
Anegasaki
Don't tell me... you saw it, that uniform？
The one with the red plaid and the yellow cardigan？
Yes... aww, so you finally saw it.
What about it？ It wasn't a weird design or anything？
Not weird... it's a foul. Yellow card.
A f-foul？ Yellow card？
The skirts are way too short. Guys won't know where to look. What do the male teachers do？
(Ah... come to think of it, those skirts were pretty short.)
Honestly, I think it's unfair for young girls to dress like that. Being young is already an advantage.
(Young... they're high schoolers, same as us...)
Anegasaki
Hey, have you heard the story about a ghost appearing at school？
No. Is there a rumor going around？
Not a rumor, it's actually been seen many times.
Not just students. Teachers and the custodian have seen it too, apparently.
Huh, that's kind of intriguing. What kind of ghost？
A little girl. About three or four. She shows up after school behind the building or in out-of-the-way places.
Couldn't it be a neighborhood kid who wandered in？
The teachers thought so too, but apparently no house nearby has a kid like that.
That's... so, what does the girl do？ Something bad？
She doesn't seem to do any harm. She just laughs happily and runs around, apparently...
That's a weird story. Doesn't fit the image of a ghost.
That's true.
Ah, right. The newspaper club is apparently investigating seriously, so maybe I'll ask them.
Anegasaki
Remember the little girl ghost I told you about？
Yeah, I remember. Actually, I was interested in it. Did you get any more info？
Yes. Guess what, someone from the newspaper club found her. And even talked to her.
Talked to the ghost？
No, she was a normal girl.
They found her crying behind the pool, apparently, because she got separated from her friend.
Oh... so it was a neighborhood kid who wandered in after all.
But there really wasn't any house nearby with a kid like her. Apparently the police came and took her.
Huh. So we know she's not a ghost, but it's a mystery in another way.
The newspaper club says they'll keep investigating.
(Investigating... our school really gets into the weirdest things...)
Anegasaki
Hey, hey, there's new info on that girl. Want to hear？
Oh, I've been waiting. So？ Do they know where she's from？
Yes. But it turns out she was from the next prefecture.
The next prefecture？ Huh, but didn't you say she was three or four？
How'd a kid like that get all the way here？
Apparently her mom is in the hospital here. So when they came to visit, she'd slip out.
So... every time she visited, she came all the way to this school？ But why？
Who knows... the details aren't clear.
Apparently her dad would come pick her up by car at the hospital at night, and she'd play at the school until then.
Kind of a hard story to get. Still, that's dangerous. A kid like that all alone.
Right. I'm glad she didn't get in an accident or get mixed up in anything.
Well, anyway, the ghost scare is all wrapped up.
Anegasaki
You know, about the ghost scare from a while ago...
Wasn't that all over？
It was, but... actually, they found out something new about the girl.
A new finding？
Yes. According to the girl, when she slipped out of the hospital, there was a friend who slipped out with her.
A friend？ Someone who came to visit too？
No, a boy she didn't know.
He asked her to play, and he seemed so lonely that she played with him, apparently...
W-wait a sec, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I've got a bad feeling about this...
Apparently at the hospital where her mom was, there was a boy who was seriously ill...
U-um, can we stop there？
According to the girl, the boy who slipped out with her looked exactly like that sick boy. And what's more...
(...Gulp.)
When the newspaper club found her, I said she was crying because she got separated from her friend, right？
Right at that very time...
I-I don't know！ I didn't hear that story. I don't know！
Anegasaki
Hey, have you ever been to the custodian's office？
Just to borrow tools for cleaning.
Then you don't know much about inside, right？ There's a bed and a kitchen, so you can stay overnight.
Ah, I see. But why do you ask？
Actually, a teacher asked me a favor, so lately I've been going sometimes.
Asked you a favor？ What？
The custodian hurt his finger. So he can't cook, which seems to be pretty inconvenient.
Cook... custodians do that too？ ...Don't tell me, so ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...？
Apparently the home ec teacher recommended me. It'd be rude to say no, so I thought I'd help.
You're kind, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Am I？ But it's good cooking practice, and I'm allowed to make a little extra, so it actually helps me out.
(Helps her out？ What does she mean？ Is it a portion for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ herself？)
Ah, come to think of it, are you still helping the custodian？
Anegasaki
Yes. Lately we've opened up and talk about all sorts of things.
Huh. What do you talk about？
Music, movies. He knows a ton about movies, so it's fun.
Music... movies？ Huh, that's pretty unexpected for him to know about.
Is it？ I think it's pretty normal.
But the custodian's a pretty old man, right？
What are you saying, that was the previous one. The current one is a young man, still in his twenties.
What!? You should've said that sooner！
I don't think it's anything to worry about.
Ah, could it be you're worried？ Don't worry, I only have eyes for you. Okay？
(I'm worried...)
Anegasaki
Hey, I have news.
What is it？
The custodian's injury finally healed. So my job's done.
I see... That's a relief.
Hehe. But actually, the custodian really took a liking to my cooking. He's asking me to keep coming to cook.
...What are you going to do about that？
I was thinking of accepting, but I figured you'd object.
Well... yeah.
So I turned it down. I told him I can't do any more, sorry.
I see... phew.
Hehe, was that a sigh of relief？ Geez, I wish you'd trust my feelings. I really only have eyes for you.
Anegasaki
About the custodian the other day...
Did something else happen？
No. Nothing anymore. But something else came up.
Something new？
Apparently the custodian talked about my cooking in the office. And the office staff got curious.
No way...
At this rate, I might get requests for lunches. What should I do then？
But wouldn't you have to make a huge amount？
I'd have them cover the ingredients. Ah, maybe I could add a little on top？ Hey, if I earn some money that way, shall I buy you something？ Hehe.
Are you really... going to do it？
...Sorry. It's true they asked, but that just now was a joke. Besides, if you make such a cute face, I could never do it.
Anegasaki
Did you know the "New School Seven Wonders" are trending lately？
New... what's that？
You know, the usual ones. The ghost in the bathroom, the stairs that gain a step, the anatomy model that moves...
Ah, every school has stuff like that.
Ours had them too, but apparently some people want to find new Seven Wonders, not the cliched ones.
Really？ But are those things you can find by looking？
Who knows. But I'd like them to do their best.
Why？
That kind of thing is like spice for school life, and an original school ghost story is lovely.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ really likes that kind of story, huh...
Anegasaki
Those people looking for the New School Seven Wonders finally formed a club.
A club？
Right. The New Seven Wonders Research Society. They get together after school and seem pretty dedicated.
If I said they have too much free time, would ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ get mad at me？
I wouldn't get mad, but I might think you're someone with no dreams.
Dreams... is that what that is？
If not dreams, then romance. Whatever you call it, I think a heart that can be moved by mysteries is important.
Hmm. You might be right about that.
I was thinking of joining the club too, but...
...I kind of figured it was going that way.
But I decided not to. I wouldn't be able to go to work, and then with you...
So I'll pass this time. It's a shame, though.
Anegasaki
Hey, apparently the New Seven Wonders Research Society found a new Wonder.
Already？
Not seven, just one so far. Do you know the small flowerbed in the back garden？
No. Was there one？
Apparently someone made it ages ago, then it was left untended. But recently it's become pretty...
Isn't someone just taking care of it？
...You think so too. Hmm, that's hardly enough to call it one of the Seven Wonders.
Maybe a transfer student who loves plants came？
Who knows？ But I'm a little curious who's doing it. Maybe I'll look into it.
For all you say, you really like this kind of thing.
Anegasaki
Remember the flowerbed in the back garden？
Yeah, I remember. Someone's taking care of it, right？
Well, I found out who's doing it. It was by chance, but I saw.
Huh. Who was it？
Well, just like you guessed.
Apparently one of the recent transfer students loves flowers. They couldn't stand the neglected flowerbed.
Well, that's a pretty girlish story. What's this transfer student like？
Aren't you misunderstanding something？ It's a boy.
A guy!?
Boys can love flowers too. And he's pretty cute. He kind of tickles the older-girl heart.
Umm, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...
Hehe, of course I'm fine. Because I have you.
But if I didn't have you, I might just hug him.
(Please give me a break, geez.)
Anegasaki
Hey, remember the tea room I told you about before？
Yeah. The old teacher taught girls tea and flower arranging, right？
Right. You know the tatami room the judo club uses now？ That used to be the tea room.
So the tea room became a martial arts room. That's quite a change.
But apparently the one who remodeled it was a female teacher too.
Huh, a female teacher？
She was apparently a national-level athlete in school. And she said judo teaches manners too, and works as self-defense.
...So did that teacher gather girls to teach too？
It wasn't just girls, apparently. But there were zero boys. She was apparently pretty beautiful too. Weird, huh？
But it's judo, right？ If she's too beautiful, that makes it harder. For guys.
Now that you say it, maybe so. ...Hehe, boys are funny.
Anegasaki
Hey, remember the female teacher who taught judo I told you about？
Yeah, I remember that.
Honestly, what do you think？ About girls doing that kind of thing.
Do you want to do it too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Not really. It's just, you know how people learn martial arts for self-defense？ I wondered if that actually works.
Who knows... but female police officers do it, so it must mean something, right？
With the police, experts teach them, so that's fine... but you know, they say a little knowledge is a dangerous thing, right？
That's a mature thing to say. But isn't it better to at least know how to protect yourself, just in case？
Fighting back badly can make the attacker angrier... I'd rather have someone protect me.
...Are you counting on me？
Yes, well. Ah, but don't push yourself to learn something, okay？ I'd hate for you to get hurt doing that.
Anegasaki
Hey, did you know？ A female police officer is coming to school to teach self-defense.
Huh, they do that？
Yes. Just for girls. Since it's better to at least know something, just in case.
Hearing that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is going to get even stronger.
Hehe. I'll pin you down tight and never let you get away.
...That's weirdly realistic.
Ah, I see. If you learn grappling, you can use it like that too. I see, I see.
(I don't think that's right...)
Anegasaki
The other day, we had the self-defense class.
Ah. How was it？
I learned a lot. But I still think it's not something an amateur can do right away.
Well, that's true.
The police officer said so too. Resisting recklessly can be dangerous, so try to call for help as much as possible.
I see.
And she said to find a nice boyfriend and have him come along wherever I go. Hehe, she's funny.
So that means what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said was right.
That's right. The rest depends on the boyfriend, I guess.
Hmm... so that means I have to get stronger after all？
Ideally. But I like you how you are now, so it's fine.
If anything happens, let's call for help together？
That's... a little uncool...
Come to think of it, what happened with the New Seven Wonders Research Society？
Anegasaki
Ah, they seem to be doing their thing, but...
I guess you can't just find them by suddenly looking.
Or rather... lately they've shifted from finding new ones to making them up.
Making them up？
They'll create new Seven Wonders in their generation and pass them on to the next class, apparently.
I see... but that changes the whole point of the group.
Right. It's creative writing, not research. They even asked me if I had any material.
Huh. Did you come up with something for them？
Hmm... I have ideas... but making them up myself feels like cheating, or like it has no romance...
Anegasaki
Remember the talk about making new School Seven Wonders the other day？
Yeah. I think ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ said you weren't really into it, right？
Right. So I decided to turn them down after all.
I see. It sounded pretty fun, though.
I was interested too. But I thought, for this kind of thing, the orthodox ones might be better.
Orthodox？
The Seven Wonders are like memories of school life, right？ I think it's important that they're the same at every school.
Um, what do you mean？
Someday, talking with people from other schools, the stairs that gain a step or the moving model are things we'd all share. But a story nobody's heard of...
Ah, I see. You'd stick out. I see, so the Seven Wonders have that role too.
It is a shame, though. I'd already thought up seven...
(...So she did make some up.)
Anegasaki
Apparently the New Seven Wonders Research Society is disbanding.
Really？
Yes. Apparently the kid who was most into it kept borrowing occult books from the library, and their parents found out.
Uh-oh.
The parents got worried, traced the cause, and found out it was the club...
That's a common story.
If it were an official club, maybe, but since it's just a hobby group, the school can't really defend it.
I see, that's rough.
I turned them down, but I think doing it is fine in itself. The people who worked hard must be shocked.
Well, can't be helped. It's grown-up stuff.
Haah... grown-up stuff, huh. It makes me want to shout, "I don't want to grow up！"
Anegasaki
Hey, have you heard？
What？
The New Seven Wonders Research Society. Seems they won't have to disband after all.
Huh, really？
Yes. The modern Japanese teacher gave an impassioned speech about not wanting to rob students of their creativity. And said he'd take responsibility for them.
Huh. There are teachers that passionate, huh.
Only, they're changing the name.
It'd be weird since they're not researching the Seven Wonders anymore, right？
I see. Did they decide on a new name？
The Urban Legend Fan Club.
Haha... what's that？
Isn't it nice？ Urban legends can be made up. I'm planning to bring them a story if I come up with an interesting one.
Anegasaki
...Haah.
What's wrong？
I was just thinking dating a younger guy is hard.
Did I do something wrong？
Huh？ ...Ah, no, it's not that. It's my friend. She seems to have fought with her boyfriend.
Oh... you scared me.
Sorry. But she's my friend, so I'm worried. I hope they make up.
What was the fight about？
I haven't heard the whole thing yet... apparently they had a big fight on a date.
I see... and on a date, too.
Right. Haah, I'm worried... I can't think of it as someone else's problem.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you seem down. Are you okay？
Anegasaki
Yeah... sorry. I was just thinking about something.
If you don't mind me, I'll listen？
Should I...
I don't know if I'll be any help, but I might be able to do something, so tell me.
Okay... actually, it's about the friend I told you about the other day.
Ah... the one who fought with her boyfriend？
Yes... apparently they ended up breaking up. After that, they kept missing each other and it all fell apart.
I see.
They were so close. Enough to make me jealous. And over one thing. I thought it's really scary... I need to be careful too.
Anegasaki
Hey, can I ask you a question？
What is it？
How many girl friends do you have？
Girl friends？
Right. It's not like you don't have any. Girls you're close to in class, for example.
Well, I talk to some, and they show me their homework... but we don't hang out together. I don't know if I'd call them friends...
I see.
You know, let me say this first: I don't mind friends like that at all.
My friend I told you about, apparently that was the cause of the fight with her boyfriend. She couldn't stand girls calling him.
I see.
I accept that it's normal to have friends and acquaintances of the opposite sex. I won't get mad about that kind of thing. I just wanted to tell you that, okay？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you seem kind of happy.
Anegasaki
Do I？ Maybe because one worry's gone... you know, my friend.
Um... the one who fought with her boyfriend？
Yes, that's right. She managed to bounce back. Actually, she seems to have a new boyfriend.
Eh？ Is that so？
And he's younger again. She never learns, or rather, she's amazing, right？
Isn't it just a coincidence？
No, it's not. When I asked, she seems to prefer younger guys. She's gentle, so she must have strong maternal instincts.
Huh. Is that how it is？
Huh, was that a loaded way of putting it？ Am I not gentle？ Am I just a meanie who only teases you？
That's not true... sorry.
Geez, don't apologize. Worrying about a little joke like that... so cute▼
Anegasaki
Come to think of it, that Urban Legend Fan Club got started the other day, right？
Ah, what was it before？ ...The Seven Wonders Investigation Society...？
No, the New Seven Wonders Research Society.
Ah, right. Come to think of it, you said you'd make up a story, right？ Did you come up with something？
Ah, I'm still thinking about that. More importantly, because of it, there's a new movement.
A new movement？
Right, another club being formed. They seem to be aiming for an unusual club, like the Urban Legend Fan Club.
"Seem to"... does ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ know who's doing it？
I have a friend who's into that sort of thing. Just a light hobby, though. She's not a weird girl or anything.
Are you joining too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hmm. I'm not that interested. Our tastes go in different directions. Horror and the occult are subtly different.
Anegasaki
Remember the friend I told you about who's trying to start a new club？
Yeah, I remember. What happened？
She decided on a name for now. The Black Magic Fan Club.
...Won't they reject it with that name？
Well, it's half a joke. My friend just picked it on a whim.
But what would they study？
Who knows... she hasn't really decided that either. She said she'd think about it.
Dress up like witches and make a racket？
That's just a costume party, geez.
Anegasaki
